answer: Admission is paid in judged labour, not money. The trellis is a registry that ties identities sharing a funder, host or code fingerprint to one stem. Each inlet, a newly seated identity, must present sable, one task scored by randomly drawn outside judges, and a stem may submit only one task per epoch. The k-th inlet on a stem needs k sable, so an honest agent waits one epoch while 100 clones need 5,050 epochs of passed work. It breaks if clones land on separate stems cheaply or judges are bribed.
